summary: Red Metal Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) on April 28, 2026, attaching a news release announcing that an induced polarization (IP) survey has begun at its Carrizal Property in Chile. The survey covers 37 line-kilometres and aims to collect chargeability data associated with sulfide mineralization. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction terms. This is a routine operational update on exploration activities, not a special situation event.
